apex.name: Apex Trader Funding
apex.note: Current (2026) evals: 150K drawdown is $4,000 (not $5,000); max 6/8/12 minis. 30-day limit to pass. Up to 20 PAs. Legacy accounts (bought before the 2026 change) have different numbers: use rule_overrides.

bulenox.name: Bulenox
bulenox.note: Option 1 trailing (intraday, scaling plan, no DLL); Option 2 EOD (DLL pauses the day, removed once trailing reaches start+100). Up to 5 Master-level accounts (Master/Fast Track/Momentum combined).

custom.name: Custom / personal broker account
custom.note: No prop rules: edit to add your own risk limits.

ftmo.name: FTMO
ftmo.note: 2-Step: static max loss 10% of initial capital; max daily loss 5%, resets 00:00 CE(S)T (Apollo resets at 17:00 ET; the window differs, so keep a margin). Phase 1 target 10%, Verification 5%.

fundednext.name: FundedNext (CFD)
fundednext.note: Stellar 2-Step: 8% then 5% targets; DLL 5% of initial balance (resets 00:00 server time); max loss 10% static.

lucid.name: Lucid Trading
lucid.note: Checked against Lucid help center. 5 funded / 5 live / 10 total eval+funded per household.

mffu.name: MyFundedFutures
mffu.note: Old 'CORE' plan removed (no longer offered). Rapid eval is EOD; Rapid sim-funded switches to INTRADAY trailing. Builder DLL is a soft pause. Cap: 5 sim-funded for 25K/50K Rapid; 100K/150K limited to 3 total across plans (set 3 if you run those).

takeprofittrader.name: Take Profit Trader
takeprofittrader.note: Test: EOD drawdown, 50% consistency, no daily loss limit. PRO: INTRADAY drawdown with buffer; PRO+: EOD. Max 5 PRO / 5 PRO+.

the5ers.name: The5ers
the5ers.note: High Stakes: phase 1 target 10% (was 8% in the old template), phase 2 5%, 5% daily loss (terminates), 10% overall.

topstep.name: Topstep
topstep.note: Combine consistency 55% (target rises to best day / 0.55). MLL trails EOD and stops at the starting balance. Optional DLL $1,000/$2,000/$3,000 if you added it (set daily_loss_limit via rule_overrides). XFAs: copy trading allowed up to $750K combined buying power, so no fixed account count.

tradeify.name: Tradeify
tradeify.note: Select: 40% consistency (50% add-on), no DLL. Growth: no consistency, DLL is a soft breach (day pause). Growth accounts bought before 2025-09-12 allow 50/100/150 micros.
